script_text: Taurus, the stars are screaming: do not spend on impulse. Saturn at 29° Pisces is exactly square Uranus at 0° Gemini, testing your 11th House of networks and your 2nd House of money. Mars has entered Aries in your 12th House, conjunct Neptune, so hidden anger and grief are surfacing. As an Earth sign ruled by Venus, you need proof, not drama; Venus in Cancer in your 3rd House warns: watch your tone in one honest call with a partner. If single, you attract a communicator through errands, siblings, or a trip. In career, Pluto in your 10th House trines Uranus in your 2nd House, so a senior ally can unlock a promotion path. In money, the Sun in Gemini in your 2nd House squares Saturn too; sign paperwork before 3 p.m. Avoid lending money to a friend; the blessing is an ally in your circle. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
